impact.text: Potential downstream issues for users expecting a minimum guaranteed payout.

precondition_sources.text: A user chooses a reward amount just above the minimum-per-epoch threshold.

intent_sources.text: The minimum reward-per-epoch invariant must be enforced on the post-fee distributedAmount, not the pre-fee amount, so the check aligns with the actual amount available for reward distribution.
